exposure: normal saline washing after uterine closure
outcome: Incidence of postoperative infections or fever
cohort: 2080 patients undergoing cesarean delivery (CD) at ≥36 gestational weeks
finding: Betadine intraperitoneal irrigation during CD appears to improve postoperative outcomes, including lower white blood cell increment, faster ambulation and intestinal recanalization, and reduced post-operative pain and infections, compared to normal saline irrigation.
